roles.description: Account that deposits and withdraws its own credited ETH
Contract that receives ETH and may call back into the vault

assumptions.statement: An ETH recipient may invoke vault functions during its receive callback

invariants.title: One depositor cannot withdraw another depositor's ETH
invariants.statement: A withdrawal by one account cannot reduce ETH backing another account's recorded balance.

invariants.title: A failed withdrawal preserves credit
invariants.statement: If the ETH transfer fails, the withdrawing account retains its recorded balance.

invariants.title: A deposit credits exactly the ETH received
invariants.statement: Every successful deposit increases only the sender's balance by exactly msg.value.
